t: Serrations on lower thread for quick and safe fastening. Non-threaded shank allows 2 materials to be pulled tightly together. Upper thread locks the deckboard securely. Cylindrical head for fixing into the groove of the deckboard. Supplied in a handy plastic tub. TX20 bit included.
b: Single Thread with Ground Serrations for Fast & Accurate Driving
